summary: Directed to implement Phase 9 ('The downstream Completeness.lean sorries and the 606 handoff'), the plan's FINAL phase, in full. Closed it completely in one green checkpoint, and with it the whole 9-phase plan. At dispatch start, Intuitionistic/Completeness.lean:191 carried the only declaration-level sorry left in the repo (intuitionisticTableau_complete, DP-3), whose docstring recorded both that openBranch_countermodel's conjunct used to be open and that the research report's bare one-liner does not type-check (a World-universe mismatch: IValid quantifies World : Type v while the countermodel frame is Nat : Type 0). Verified the report-quote caveat directly (did not assume the bare one-liner shape), then closed DP-3 by pinning the theorem's own hypothesis to IValid.{_, 0} phi -- mirroring minimalTableau_complete's existing MValid.{_, 0} pin -- and discharging the body with exact @h Nat (intAccessPreorder edges) (intExtractValuation _b) _huc 0 (IValid has no separate bot_forces argument, so _hbuc is simply unused, unlike MValid's proof). This pin is a breaking change to the theorem's public type: a scoped build of Intuitionistic/DecisionProcedure.lean immediately surfaced two call-site breaks (intuitionisticTableau_decides, instDecidableIValid), fixed by building the IValid analogue of Minimal/DecisionProcedure.lean's mvalid_descend/mvalid_universe_invariant bridge (ivalid_descend/ivalid_universe_invariant, simplified since IValid carries no bot_forces to transport) and re-pinning/re-routing those two declarations plus instDecidableDerivableIntPropAxiom exactly as the Minimal side already does. A repo-wide lake build then surfaced a THIRD, further-downstream break at SequentCalculus/LJ/Decidability.lean's instDecidableLJDerivable (not named in the plan's file list, discovered only by the full build), fixed the same way via a local letI routing through ivalid_universe_invariant. Rewrote the in-source prohibition and 'Notes on sorry' in both Completeness.lean files (confirmed via grep that Minimal/Completeness.lean's counterpart prohibition text had already been fully retired by task 605, so nothing to rewrite there beyond stale sorry-status prose), and additionally corrected four more files' (Intuitionistic/DecisionProcedure.lean, Minimal/DecisionProcedure.lean, Metalogic/IntDecidability.lean, Metalogic/MinDecidability.lean) parallel 'carries a deferred sorryAx' claims that were now false -- a scope expansion beyond the plan's literally-named files, done for documentation accuracy, not because the build required it. Left Scheme.lean's historical STOP-gate note (which cites stale sorry line numbers) untouched: it is explicitly self-labeled historical/superseded and Scheme.lean is outside Phase 9's declared scope. Full CI pipeline green twice (before and after the two purely-doc-only Metalogic-file edits): lake build 3325 jobs, checkInitImports clean, lake lint zero findings in any of the 7 touched files, lint-style clean, shake no suggestion for touched files, mk_all no update necessary, lake test 9397 jobs exit 0 zero cross marks. Declaration-level sorry count (whole repo, lake build's authoritative signal): 1 -> 0. The repo has zero declaration-level sorries. Axiom count 26 -> 26, vacuous-definition grep 1 -> 1 (both unchanged, pre-existing). intuitionisticTableau_complete, minimalTableau_complete, instDecidableDerivableIntPropAxiom, instDecidableLJDerivable, and ivalid_descend all re-verified via lean_verify after a genuinely fresh lake build: standard axioms only, no sorryAx. Marked the plan's Phase 9 [COMPLETED] and its plan-level Status field [COMPLETED] -- all 9 phases of the plan are now complete. Wrote a full task summary and a detailed Phase 9 handoff, updated state.json's artifact list and regenerated TODO.md, and committed everything task-609-scoped in one commit.

Built a dedicated ivalid_descend/ivalid_universe_invariant bridge for IValid rather than trying to reuse mvalid_descend/mvalid_universe_invariant directly -- IValid and MValid are distinct defs (IValid has no separate bot_forces argument), so the transport lemma has to be proved for IValid's own shape, though the technique (ULift lift-and-transport) is identical and the IValid proof is strictly simpler (no bot_forces case to carry).

Fixed SequentCalculus/LJ/Decidability.lean's instDecidableLJDerivable via the same local-letI-through-ivalid_universe_invariant pattern instDecidableDerivableIntPropAxiom already uses, rather than inventing a different fix, for consistency with the landed precedent.
